title: 25 States Brought Cursive Back After It Nearly Vanished
hook: Cursive looked obsolete. Now 25 states require schools to teach it.
closing: Cursive literacy keeps handwritten records readable, so this comeback affects more than penmanship class.
question: Can you still read cursive?

segments.say: Cursive instruction now reaches 25 states by law, showing schools are reversing its long decline.
About 67% of young Americans cannot read cursive, leaving many handwritten records difficult to access without help.
Cursive covers 80% of National Archives holdings, so reading it can matter for direct access to historical records.
